positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
C# and .NET framework
JavaScript, React, and Node

positions.title: Quality Assurance
positions.description:
Works closely with Product and Engineering throughout the Agile Software Development lifecycle
Personally tests all features and bug fixes across QA, Integ, Staging, and Production environments
Handles all release specific, build verification, and regression testing for every major deployment
Troubleshoots any issues found, provides detailed breakdown, and follows through to resolution
Writes positive and negative test cases for QA Automation to be included with future regression
Provides feedback at the close of every Sprint to improve process

SkySlope's Employee of the Year 2016 - based on an internal company wide vote

Dev Resources: Microsoft Visual Studio, Sublime Text, Cloud9, Notepad++, React, Node.js, Express
Testing Resources: Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm, Chrome Dev Tools, Postman, MVS Web Tests
Deploy Resources: SourceTree, GitHub, Bitbucket, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline
Languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, XML, C#, Ruby
Team Resources: JIRA, Slack, Confluence

positions.title: Technical Support Supervisor
positions.description:
Technical Support Supervisor working as a bridge for communication between customers, Product, Engineering, and upper Management
Owns all support tickets related to Bugs in the platform and unresolved issues with a customer's Browser, Machine, or OS
Streamlined troubleshooting and ticket resolution process for the entire Support department

Most Loved Customer Support Representative 2016 - based on a full year of customer satisfaction surveys

Operating Systems: Windows 7, 8, and 10 - Mac OS 10.10 and 10.11 - Linux Ubuntu
Browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Internet Explorer, Safari, and Brave
Mobile: Android 6 and 7 - iOS 9 and 10

positions.title: Quality Assurance Agent
positions.description:
Analyzed the quality of work for a team of claim adjusters within a call center environment
Top priorities were to catch errors in coverage, policy, and amount paid for each claim reviewed
Worked with development team to test new software that would automatically determine claim coverage

positions.title: Project Manager and Carpenter
positions.description:
Worked hands on in all aspects of residential home construction
Communicated directly with clients to outline budgets, finalize bids, and resolve complications
Liaison between clients, sub-contractors, and lenders through the life of each project

positions.title: Academic Intern
positions.description:
Academic internship to help earn public and private grants for the Outdoor Recreation Program
Created resources to quantify the impact of the program on children from underserved populations

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Customer service and retail sales in the residential landscape industry
Youngest employee to earn a California Nurseryman Certification (#9004124)
Focused on landscape design and customer consultation after certification
